test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Follow Suit

options.text: To do as others have done

solution:
The correct answer is **'To do as others have done'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

__
 
• The meaning of the phrase '**Follow Suit**' is to **do the same thing as someone else has done**.
 
• **Example**: *As soon as the United States of America banned cryptocurrency, other countries **followed suit**__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• **Follow Suit: **अनुकरण करना
 
• **Example**: *When Rohan got a tattoo on his arm, his classmates **followed suit.**__*
